page.overview:
Who is Marceline the Vampire Queen?

Marceline the Vampire Queen is an Adventure Time minifigure introduced in 2016 as part of LEGO Dimensions.

Marceline is the daughter of the Nightosphere ruler Hunson Abadeer and a human woman named Elise. She was a vampire hunter until she was bitten by the Vampire King, and since then she's known as Marceline the Vampire Queen. She doesn't need to suck blood, she just needs to feed on the color of red things.

Marceline is a purchasable skin in-game for 1,500 V-Bucks or with the Adventure Time Bundle for 3,800 V-Bucks.
